nodes.label: Tests for runtime verification module. Tests cover: 1. Health check success 2.…
A missing HTTP client must not be treated as a healthy runtime.
A real HTTP 200 from the primary health endpoint passes.
Health check falls back to /health when /api/health fails.
Health check falls back to / when /health fails.
Health check fails when all endpoints fail.
Browser helpers must not claim success without executing a browser.
Application start fails if process crashes.
Test graceful shutdown and force kill.
Process is force killed when graceful shutdown times out.
Stop succeeds when no process is running.
A snapshot may support planning, but cannot certify a running learner route.
